grammar.summary: 本课学习 mistake/ slip 语义辨析与现场纠错。

points.title: a slip of the tongue 固定短语
points.explanation: 口误 = a slip of the tongue；笔误 = a slip of the pen。slip 强调无心之失，mistake 泛指错误。

examples.en: He made a slip of the tongue during the performance.

points.title: as 表"正当"的时间从句
points.explanation: Just as he was about to speak... be about to do = 正要做（最近的将来）。

examples.en: He was about to announce the winner.
